thread:
Nina: FYI FinSecure RFP: must have EU-only control plane and no US subprocessors for any telemetry. They want a 30-day POC. Can we scope a short presales plan and a one-paragraph attestation? cc @Omar @Priya

Omar: Quick checks: 1) BYO-KMS required? 2) Can they accept disabling telemetry for the POC if control-plane locality can't be guaranteed?

Priya (acct): BYO-KMS yes. They said telemetry to non-EU subprocessors is a hard no; however they said a time-limited attestation + telemetry-off during pilot is acceptable for presales review.

Raul (ops): Reality: Hosted control plane is us-central; data plane can be pinned to eu-west-1. For a POC we can: tenant-pin -> eu-west-1 compute, enable BYO-KMS in eu-west-1, disable tracing/logging, and opt-out of Datadog/Sentry for that tenant. That will keep payloads in EU and avoid known US subprocessors for telemetry.

Nina: Great. Can you list which subprocessors would still be in the loop (if any) and whether Cloudflare EU POPs are OK?

Raul: Subprocessors touching payload: AWS eu-west-1 (compute), customer's KMS (eu-west-1). Subprocessors that normally touch metadata: GCP logging (us-central), Datadog (us), Sentry (us). For the POC we'll disable those integrations. Cloudflare EU POPs are acceptable if we ensure no edge logs are shipped to non-EU storage (we can disable edge logging for tenant).

Omar: Proposed minimal POC config:
```yaml
tenant: finsecure-poc
region_pin: eu-west-1
byo_kms: true
telemetry: disabled
edge_logging: disabled
routing: failure_mode: reject
```

Priya: Pricing request: small pilot (200 req/day, ~100 tokens). Need 30-day pilot number and also an estimate for Dedicated EU-control-plane for prod.

Raul: Ballpark: one-time ops/setup +$1k, manual attestation work +$500, monthly ops overhead for pilot +$600. Dedicated EU-control-plane (prod) starting ~11k/mo for minimal reserved capacity and DU provisioning. I'll open INF ticket.

infra-bot: Ticket INF-7123 created: "FinSecure EU POC: BYO-KMS + telemetry-off." Assigned to Raul.

legal-bot: Draft attestation suggested:
"During the scoped 30-day proof-of-concept, Redwood will: 1) Pin tenant compute to EU (eu-west-1), 2) Configure customer-managed KMS in eu-west-1, 3) Disable telemetry/tracing and third-party analytics for the tenant, and 4) Disable edge logging to ensure no telemetry leaves EU. This attestation is technical and time-limited; contractual commitments to EU-only control-plane and subprocessors require Dedicated/Private deployment and a signed amendment."

Nina: Thanks all. Omar/Priya, please add runbook + cost breakdown to the ticket. I'll share the attestation with FinSecure and ask whether short-lived VPC peering is needed.

Omar: Will upload runbook in 3 hrs.

Priya: I'll message customer with attestation and pricing ETA by EOD.
